extensionDescription.message: Local archive for your own Venice.ai conversations: export, import, and lineage-aware merge. Nothing leaves your machine.

sourceNoRuns.message: No runs yet — export from an open venice.ai conversation tab.

syncDue.message: Auto-sync reminder: last run is older than $MINUTES$ minutes.

importNote.message: Files are inspected first — nothing is written until you confirm.

importBranch.message: Branch or edit — flagged, never auto-resolved: $COUNT$

emptyLog.message: Ready. Exports and imports are logged here, newest last.

logScrapeStart.message: Reading conversation from the active venice.ai tab…

logCaptureStored.message: Raw capture stored before any serialization (snapshot before read).

logMerged.message: Merge plan — added $ADDED$, unchanged $UNCHANGED$, extended $EXTENDED$, prefix $PREFIX$, branch $BRANCH$.

logRunPass.message: PASS — every write completed; nothing was replaced.

logRunFailed.message: FAILED — $COUNT$ item(s) did not complete; earlier files remain intact.

logInspectDone.message: Inspection complete — review the dry run, then commit.

logImportCommitted.message: Import committed — added $ADDED$, extended $EXTENDED$. Flagged items were stored, not merged.

logImportFlaggedNote.message: Prefix/branch conflicts are kept under review in the library; resolve them deliberately, never automatically.

logDataCleared.message: All stored data cleared (explicit user action).

errNoVeniceTab.message: No active venice.ai tab found — open a conversation, then export.

errZeroMessages.message: Zero messages scraped — selectors matched nothing readable. Not writing an empty file. Open a conversation with messages and try again.

errFolderPermission.message: Folder access was denied — exports fell back to the Downloads dialog. Re-select the folder to reconnect.

countsSummary.message: Snapshot file count: $FILES$ · conversation count: $CONVERSATIONS$ · message count: $MESSAGES$ — three different counts; never read one as another.

optFloatingButtonDesc.message: A small 'Archive with Venice Vault' button in the page corner. Off by default; the page is otherwise untouched.

optFormatsDesc.message: Each format is written as separate timestamped files; existing files are never replaced. Default: JSON only. Use the Bundle for moving machines — it carries version history.

formatBundle.message: Bundle (vault migration — re-imports into Venice Vault, includes lineage)

optFilenameTemplateDesc.message: Tokens: {date} {time} {title} {ext}. Components are sanitized for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

optAskSaveLocation.message: Ask where to save each file

optAskSaveLocationDesc.message: Opens a save dialog per file. Off by default: files go to your Downloads folder with unique names.

optAutoSyncDesc.message: Off by default. This is a reminder shown when you open the popup — the extension never runs in the background on its own.

diagnosticsDesc.message: Writes a redacted support report: sizes, counts, schema versions, problem counts. No conversation text, no record IDs, no local paths.

clearDataDesc.message: Removes every capture, version, and preference stored by this extension. Files already written to disk are not touched.

confirmClear.message: Click again to confirm — this cannot be undone

confirmClearNote.message: Destructive action: click once to arm, again to confirm. The request expires after 5 seconds.

logBulkStart.message: Bulk export started — reading your conversation list…

logBulkListScraped.message: Conversation list read: $COUNT$ conversations. Visiting each one; this takes a while.

logBulkCancelled.message: Bulk export cancelled — already-scraped conversations are kept and exported.

logBulkDone.message: Bulk export finished: $CONVERSATIONS$ of $LISTED$ conversations; $FAILURES$ item(s) failed.

errNoConversationList.message: Could not read your conversation list: $DETAIL$ Open the venice.ai chats list view (where conversations are listed), then try again.

logImportLineageMerged.message: Bundle lineage migrated: $VERSIONS$ versions, $OCCURRENCES$ occurrences, $FLAGGED$ flagged restored; $INVALID$ invalid entries skipped.

bannerHostPermission.message: Firefox has not granted venice.ai access for this extension version (temporary add-ons reset this on every reload). Without it, scraping cannot run.

grantSuccess.message: venice.ai access granted — exports will work now.

grantFailed.message: Access was not granted. You can also enable it in about:addons → Venice Vault → Permissions.

errHostPermission.message: MISSING HOST PERMISSION: Firefox has not granted venice.ai access for this extension version. Fix: about:addons → Venice Vault → Permissions → enable "Access your data for venice.ai" (this resets on every temporary-add-on reload), or use the Grant button in the popup. Nothing was stored from this run.

accessNotGranted.message: Not granted yet — exports and the floating button need this.

importStoredNote.message: Stored in Venice Vault’s local library (browser storage — not written to disk). Use Export to produce files. Note: temporary add-on storage does not survive browser restarts.

logStaleReload.message: This page had scripts from an older Venice Vault version — reloading the tab once to load the current scraper, then retrying.

runRestoredLive.message: Reattached to the running export — progress and log restored.

runInterrupted.message: This run was interrupted (the background worker restarted mid-run). Nothing was lost — run Export all again to continue.
